name: Shinobi Aptitudes — Basic Book source reference
description: This is a category reference for Shinobi Aptitudes. The Basic Book calls aptitudes “Skills” in its English translation. The Basic Book, page 57, defines Combat, Maneuvering, Skill Enhancements, Shinobi and General skills; the free-choice summary begins on page 58. Individual ability entries are NOT included in this reference item.
